properties.name: Denver, CO to Brooks Lake, WY (via Dubois)
properties.description: Primary Day 1 driving route: I-25 north to Laramie, then WY/US highways west through Rawlins and Riverton to Dubois, continuing on US-26/287 toward Togwotee Pass with a short spur onto Warm Springs Creek Rd (passing the Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs backup camping area) before returning to the highway and following Brooks Lake Rd (FR 515) up to Brooks Lake. Approx. 460 miles / 9h25m of driving (no stops), road-snapped from OpenStreetMap routing data -- not a field-verified GPS track. This distance and time deliberately EXCLUDE the Union Pass reference point below, which is not part of this route. Brooks Lake Rd (FR 515) has had past temporary closures due to debris flow near Togwotee Pass -- confirm current road status with the Shoshone National Forest before traveling.

properties.name: Union Pass (optional reference -- not part of Day 1 route)
properties.description: Historic Continental Divide crossing south of Dubois, elev. ~9,210 ft. Kept visible for reference only, per planning decision: it is NOT included in the Day 1 driving route, mileage, or driving-time calculations above. A legally-researched dispersed-camping search area along FR 263 near the pass is shown separately below.

properties.name: Brooks Lake dispersed-camping corridor (FR 515)
properties.description: Legally-researched search area: a 300-ft motor-vehicle corridor on both sides of FR 515 (Brooks Lake Rd), from its junction with US-26/287 up to Brooks Lake. Basis: the Shoshone National Forest Wind River/Washakie Ranger Districts' 2026 Motor Vehicle Use Map (South Half, north sheet) states 'Motor vehicle use off designated roads for the purpose of dispersed camping is permitted for up to 300 feet from the centerline of the road, allowing the same vehicles the road allows and the same season as the road is open and resource damage does not occur,' applying to all roads on the map except developed-campground access roads. FR 515 itself carries no exception on that MVUM. EXCLUDED from this polygon (not buffered): the numbered campground spurs 515.1D and 515.1F (Brooks Lake Campground access) and 515.1G (Pinnacles Campground access), which the same MVUM lists as 'Entire Route Prohibited' for dispersed camping under 'All FS Developed Campground Roads.' The Brooks Lake Campground point itself falls inside this polygon's outer buffer geometrically but is NOT a legal dispersed site -- camp only off the FR 515 roadbed, not on campground loop roads. NOT checked against this polygon: private inholdings, and precise stream/wetland setbacks (the MVUM's only numeric condition is the 300-ft/centerline rule plus a general 'no resource damage' requirement -- no separate water-setback distance was found for this district). FR 515 was closed at its US-26 junction by a debris-flow closure as of July 31, 2026, with no confirmed reopening found -- verify current status before relying on this area. Verified 2026-10-19 against the cited MVUM; road centerline geometry cross-checked against OpenStreetMap's FS 515-tagged ways.

properties.name: Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs dispersed-camping corridor (FR 532)
properties.description: Legally-researched search area: a 300-ft motor-vehicle corridor on both sides of FR 532 (Warm Springs Creek Rd), from its junction with US-26/287 to the dead-end turnaround at the documented Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs dispersed-camping spot. Basis: same 2026 Shoshone NF Wind River/Washakie MVUM rule as the Brooks Lake area above -- the blanket 300-ft/centerline dispersed-camping allowance, with no exception listed for FR 532 or this spur on that MVUM (only one route-specific exception exists on this sheet, 532.2D, a different spur not part of this corridor). Road identity cross-checked against OpenStreetMap way 336768126 ('Warm Springs Loop', ref FS 532, name_base 'Warm Springs Creek'). NOT checked: private inholdings and precise stream/wetland setbacks (see Brooks Lake area note -- same caveat applies). Verified 2026-10-19.

properties.name: Union Pass dispersed-camping corridor (FR 263, optional)
properties.description: Legally-researched search area, OPTIONAL scouting reference only -- not part of the Day 1 route or mileage. A 300-ft motor-vehicle corridor on both sides of FR 263 (Union Pass Rd), from the pass itself northwest to where the road's OSM-tagged 'ref=263' designation ends (the road continues further northwest as a different-numbered route). Basis: same 2026 Shoshone NF MVUM blanket 300-ft/centerline dispersed-camping rule as the other two areas; no route-specific exception for 263 appears on that MVUM. This stretch of Union Pass Rd lies within Shoshone National Forest (Wind River Ranger District) per the MVUM's own forest-boundary line, which runs just southwest of the pass -- Bridger-Teton National Forest begins on the far side of that boundary and was checked but is not implicated by this polygon. Road identity cross-checked against OpenStreetMap ways 15732727/15732729 (name 'Union Pass Road', name_1 'Road 263'). NOT checked: private inholdings and precise stream/wetland setbacks (see Brooks Lake area note). Verified 2026-10-19.

properties.name: Brooks Lake -- PRIMARY overnight scouting destination
properties.description: PRELIMINARY SCOUTING LOCATION, not a confirmed legal campsite. This is the primary Day 1 dispersed-camping scouting target, near Brooks Lake / Brooks Lake Campground in the Shoshone National Forest (elev. ~9,200 ft). The surrounding FR 515 corridor's general legal eligibility for dispersed camping IS now verified (see the green Brooks Lake dispersed-camping search area) -- but this exact point is still just a reported coordinate from a third-party camping directory, not a field-confirmed site, so the precise spot, its distance from water, and ground suitability remain unresearched.

properties.name: Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs -- BACKUP overnight scouting area
properties.description: PRELIMINARY SCOUTING LOCATION, not a confirmed legal campsite. This is the Day 1 BACKUP camping area if Brooks Lake doesn't work out: dispersed sites off Warm Springs Creek Rd (confirmed as FR 532) in the Shoshone National Forest, about 18 miles west of Dubois, elev. ~7,750 ft. Listed under both the "Sheridan Creek" and "Warm Springs" names in different camping directories -- treat as the same general area. The surrounding FR 532 corridor's general legal eligibility for dispersed camping IS now verified (see the green Sheridan Creek / Warm Springs search area) -- but this exact point is still just a reported coordinate from a third-party camping directory, not a field-confirmed site.

properties.name: Pinnacles Campground
properties.description: Developed USFS campground on Brooks Lake Rd (FR 515/516), immediately adjacent to Brooks Lake. Fallback if the Brooks Lake dispersed-camping scouting doesn't pan out.

properties.name: National Bighorn Sheep Interpretive Center
properties.description: Visitor center and museum on US-26 in Dubois dedicated to the Wind River bighorn sheep herd. Worthwhile stop while passing through town.

properties.name: Cowboy Cafe (Dubois, WY)
properties.description: Breakfast/lunch/dinner diner on E. Ramshorn Ave in Dubois, open since 1993. Buffalo burgers, wild-game dishes, and well-reviewed pie.

properties.name: Rustic Pine Tavern (Dubois, WY)
properties.description: Long-running local tavern on E. Ramshorn St in Dubois; went smoke-free in 2020 under new ownership.

properties.name: TA Travel Center (Rawlins, WY -- I-80 Exit 214)
properties.description: 24-hour truck stop with diesel pumps, truck parking, and CAT scale, right on the route north of Denver.

properties.name: Sinclair / Pit Stop Travel Center (Riverton, WY)
properties.description: Listed as a truck stop with diesel and truck parking on S. Federal Blvd in Riverton, the last larger town before Dubois. Sources disagree on whether this station currently pumps diesel -- confirm before counting on it.
